_doc: Units of the Official Records organization tables that the roster lacks, splits or lists with another status. Built by tools/build_roster_gaps.py: every quote was found by code in the OR text at the offset given (the OCR is printed as it stands). action: add | absent | attached | merge | fix | status. A reading aid: each line is confirmed by a `unit` or `absent` record of its group file before it changes the roster.
